messages:
Anya: Quick request — need a set of benchmark graphics + a single-slide diagram for next Tues webinar. Core asks: three hero tiles (social-sized), a 1200x600 hero for the webinar page, and a single-slide ‘bench matrix’ that visualizes latency vs cost tradeoffs. Brand-safe colors, accessible text, and an alt-text sheet. Can we get first drafts by EOD Fri?
Matt: On it. Any source Figma or reference comps? Also static or animated for the social tiles?
Anya: Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/bench-templates — I added a page called "Mar 2026 webinar". Static for launch + one GIF micro-variant (800x800) if time.
Sasha: I'll drop concise headlines and short captions tomorrow morning. For the bench matrix, prefer numeric labels and three curves (small/medium/large) + a bold recommended-config line.
Oliver: Brand note: avoid the neon secondary gradient for print. Use the two approved palettes only. Logo lockup needs 24px clearspace; use dark or white mark based on background.
Matt: Accessibility checklist I'm applying:
- Contrast >= 4.5:1 for body copy
- Headline contrast >= 3:1 allowed if decorative
- Alt text: 1 sentence + 2 bullets of context
- SVGs: keep text as text (no outlines)
- Colorblind check: don’t rely solely on red/green
I'll make editable templates with text layers.
design-bot: Figma page created: "Mar 2026 webinar" (3 tiles + hero + bench slide). Version: v4. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/bench-templates?node-id=240%3A12
Matt: Uploaded export spec in figma comments. Filename convention example:
redwood_bench_tile_social_1200x1200_v1.png
redwood_webinar_hero_1200x600_v1.png
redwood_bench_matrix_slide_16x9_v1.pdf
Also added exact px sizes and slice regions.
Sasha: Proposed headlines: "Serving wins: latency vs cost", "Optimize inference economics", "Predictable latency for products". I'll add alt-text suggestions and short captions in the doc.
Oliver: Legal flag — include attribution for any third-party benchmarks. If internal figures, label as "Redwood internal benchmark, Mar 2026". If third-party logos appear, Legal needs clearance; otherwise use plain text attribution.
Anya: Legal — can you do a sweep on the slide copy + attribution line by Mon 12:00 PT?
Legal: Acknowledged. Will review Mon morning; if we use vendor marks we'll need a quick clearance note.
Matt: One more: bench matrix — do we plot multiple curves per model class or an aggregated point cloud?
Anya: Include three faint curves (small/medium/large) plus a bold recommended-config line. Keep the legend minimal; Sasha will provide concise labels.
Sasha: Labels: Small = fast/low-cost, Medium = balanced, Large = high-quality. I'll add short microcopy in figma notes.
Matt: I'll hand off the first static drafts by Fri EOD. GIF micro-variant if time, otherwise in next sprint.
Anya: Thanks all — priority order: webinar hero + bench slide first, then tiles. Ping if blockers. :rocket:
